description: This Java source file defines the class 'EtbTestSequence', which initiates a sequence of commands to test electronic throttle body (ETB) control by adjusting throttle positions over time. It includes nested class 'EtbTarget' for representing individual steps in the sequence, and interacts with external components such as sensors, command queues, and logging.

classes.name: EtbTestSequence
classes.description: Main class managing a sequence of ETB control commands for testing, including UI button and executor management.

classes.name: EtbTarget
classes.description: Nested class representing individual throttle position targets with durations and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: EtbTestSequence()
methods.description: Constructor setting up action listener on the button to start the sequence and metric.

methods.name: getButton()
methods.description: Returns the UI button associated with the test sequence.

methods.name: addNext()
methods.description: Adds the next target in the sequence with specified duration and position.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Executes the target by sending command to set throttle position and scheduling the next target.
